Any time a man gits shot outa Casey Ryan's stage, he'll have to jump out an' wait for the bullet to ketch up. And there ain't any passengers offn' this stage layin' busted in no canyon, neither. I bring in what I start out with."

72655-continental-stagecraft.creator: Unknown
72655-continental-stagecraft.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. faint echo of what was to be found on the Continent. arxiv-2109-06464.title: The bundle of KMS state spaces for flows on a unital C ∗ C^{*} -algebra
arxiv-2109-06464.creator: George A. Elliott and Klaus Thomsen
arxiv-2109-06464.description:
A 2021 arXiv research paper by George A. Elliott and Klaus Thomsen. Introduction

The collection of KMS state spaces for a flow on a unital
C^{*}
-algebra can be thought of as a bundle of simplices over the real line. This may seem like a far-fetched analogy to other more established notions of bundles because the fibers of the bundle may be empty or they may all be mutually non-isomorphic, but we will show here that it is in fact a well-behaved and useful concept.

arxiv-2110-12250.title: Localised Dirac eigenmodes and Goldstone’s theorem at finite temperature
arxiv-2110-12250.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by *. I show that a finite density of near-zero localised Dirac modes can lead to the disappearance of the massless excitations predicted by the finite-temperature version of Goldstone’s theorem in the chirally broken phase of a gauge theory.

arxiv-2207-12356.title: The evolution of the galaxy UV luminosity function at redshifts 𝐳 ≃ 𝟖 \mathbf{z\simeq 8} – 𝟏𝟓 \mathbf{15} from deep JWST and ground-based near-infrared imaging 2022 The evolution of the galaxy UV luminosity function at redshifts 𝐳 ≃ 𝟖 \mathbf{z\simeq 8} – 𝟏𝟓 \mathbf{15} from deep JWST and ground-bas
arxiv-2207-12356.creator: C. T. Donnan, D. J. McLeod, J. S. Dunlop, R. J. McLure, A. C. Carnall, R. Begley, F. Cullen M. L. Hamadouche, R. A. A. Bowler, D. Magee, H. J. McCracken, B. Milvang-Jensen A. Moneti & T. Targett
arxiv-2207-12356.description: Abstract We reduce and analyse the available James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) ERO and ERS NIRCam imaging (SMACS0723, GLASS, CEERS) in combination with the latest deep ground-based near-infrared imaging in the COSMOS field (provided by UltraVISTA DR5) to produce a new measurement of the evolving galaxy UV luminosity function (LF) over the redshift range z = 8 − 15 z=8-15

arxiv-2211-13350.title: Choreographer: Learning and Adapting Skills in Imagination
arxiv-2211-13350.creator: Pietro Mazzaglia, Tim Verbelen, Bart Dhoedt Alexandre Lacoste Sai Rajeswar
arxiv-2211-13350.description: Abstract Unsupervised skill learning aims to learn a rich repertoire of behaviors without external supervision, providing artificial agents with the ability to control and influence the environment. However, without appropriate knowledge and exploration, skills may provide control only over a restricted area of the environment, limiting their applicability.

arxiv-2310-07535.title: Fairness under Covariate Shift: Improving Fairness-Accuracy tradeoff with few Unlabeled Test Samples
arxiv-2310-07535.creator: Shreyas Havaldar Google Research India shreyasjh@google.com, Jatin Chauhan UCLA chauhanjatin100@gmail.com Karthikeyan Shanmugam Google Research India karthikeyanvs@google.com Jay Nandy Fujitsu Research India jayjaynandy@gmail.com Aravindan RaghuveerGoogle Research India araghuveer@google.com
arxiv-2310-07535.description: Abstract Covariate shift in the test data is a common practical phenomena that can significantly downgrade both the accuracy and the fairness performance of the model. Ensuring fairness across different sensitive groups under covariate shift is of paramount importance due to societal implications like criminal justice.

arxiv-2310-18395.title: Undermassive Host Galaxies of Five z ∼ 6 z\sim 6 Luminous Quasars Detected with JWST Facilities: JWST(NIRCam, NIRSpec) Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) , Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , NumPy ( van der Walt et al. 2011 ) , photutils ( Bradley et al. 2022
arxiv-2310-18395.creator: Meredith A. Stone, Jianwei Lyu (吕建伟), George H. Rieke, Stacey Alberts, Kevin N. Hainline
arxiv-2310-18395.description: Abstract We measure host galaxy stellar masses for a sample of five luminous quasars at z ∼ 5 − 7 z\sim 5-7 . Using JWST/NIRCam medium-band images of nearby PSF reference stars, we carefully subtract the contribution from the quasar light to place upper and lower limits on the flux of each host galaxy.

arxiv-2311-18130.title: The Trifecta: Three simple techniques for training deeper Forward-Forward networks
arxiv-2311-18130.creator: Thomas Dooms, Ing Jyh Tsang & Jose Oramas
arxiv-2311-18130.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Thomas Dooms, Ing Jyh Tsang & Jose Oramas. Modern machine learning models are able to outperform humans on a variety of non-trivial tasks. However, as the complexity of the models increases, they consume significant amounts of power and still struggle to generalize effectively to unseen data. Local learning, which focuses on updating subsets of a model’s parameters at a time, has emerged as a promising technique to address these issues.

arxiv-2312-04712.title: Error Discovery By Clustering Influence Embeddings
arxiv-2312-04712.creator: Fulton WangMeta, Julius AdebayoPrescient Design / GenentechSarah TanCornell UniversityDiego Garcia-OlanoMetaNarine KokhlikyanMeta
arxiv-2312-04712.description: Abstract We present a method for identifying groups of test examples—slices—on which a model under-performs, a task now known as slice discovery . We formalize coherence —a requirement that erroneous predictions, within a slice, should be wrong for the same reason —as a key property that any slice discovery method should satisfy.

arxiv-2403-14451.title: Phenology curve estimation via a mixed model representation of functional principal components: Characterizing time series of satellite-derived vegetation indices
arxiv-2403-14451.creator: Inder Tecuapetla-Gómez (1,2), Francisco Rosales-Marticorena (3), Berenice Fanny Galicia-Gómez (4)
arxiv-2403-14451.description: Abstract . Vegetation phenology consists of studying synchronous stationary events, such as the vegetation green up and leaves senescence, that can be construed as adaptive responses to climatic constraints. In this paper, we propose a method to estimate the annual phenology curve from multi-annual observations of time series of vegetation indices derived from satellite images.

arxiv-2504-19155.title: Machine Learning-Based Modeling of the Anode Heel Effect in X-ray Beam Monte Carlo Simulations
arxiv-2504-19155.creator: Hussein Harb, Didier Benoit, Axel Rannou, Chi-Hieu Pham, Valentin Tissot, Bahaa Nasr, Julien Bert
arxiv-2504-19155.description: Abstract This study enhances Monte Carlo simulation accuracy in X-ray imaging by developing an AI-driven model for the anode heel effect, achieving improved beam intensity distribution and dosimetric precision. Through dynamic adjustments to beam weights on the anode and cathode sides of the X-ray tube, our machine learning model effectively replicates the asymmetry characteristic of clinical X-ray beams.

arxiv-2507-07313.title: Frontier LLMs Still Struggle with Simple Reasoning Tasks
arxiv-2507-07313.creator: Alan Malek, Jiawei Ge, Nevena Lazic, Chi Jin, András György, Csaba Szepesvári
arxiv-2507-07313.description: Abstract While state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) demonstrate advanced reasoning capabilities—achieving remarkable performance on challenging competitive math and coding benchmarks—they also frequently fail on tasks that are easy for humans. This work studies the performance of frontier LLMs on a broad set of such “easy” reasoning problems.

arxiv-2507-15949.title: Colliders are Testing neither Locality via Bell’s Inequality nor Entanglement versus Non-Entanglement Preprint: BONN-TH-2025-22, IPPP/25/48
arxiv-2507-15949.creator: Steven A. Abel, Herbi K. Dreiner, Rhitaja Sengupta, Lorenzo Ubaldi
arxiv-2507-15949.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Steven A. Abel, Herbi K. Dreiner, Rhitaja Sengupta, Lorenzo Ubaldi. Recently there has been an increased interest in possible tests of locality via Bell’s inequality or tests of entanglement at colliders, in particular at the LHC. These have involved various physical processes, such as t ​ t ¯ t\bar{t} , or τ + ​ τ − \tau^{+}\tau^{-} production, or the decay of a Higgs boson to 2 vector bosons H → V ​ V ∗ H\to VV^{*} .

To define the genetic basis of MCCs, we performed exome sequencing of 49 MCCs. We show that MCPyV-negative MCCs...

pmc-10665612.title: Stricturing Crohn's disease: what is the role of endoscopic stenting? A systematic review
pmc-10665612.creator: Giorgia Burrelli Scotti, Roberto Lorenzetti, Annalisa Aratari, Antonietta Lamazza, Enrico Fiori, Claudio Papi, Stefano Festa
pmc-10665612.description: Background/AimsEndoscopic stenting for stricturing Crohn's disease (CD) is an emerging treatment that achieves more persistent dilatation of the stricture over time than endoscopic balloon dilatation (EBD). We aimed to explore the efficacy and safety of stenting for the treatment of CD strictures.MethodsA systematic electronic literature search was performed (PROSPERO; no. CRD42022308033).

pmc-11510847.title: Predicting Athlete Workload in Women’s Rugby Sevens Using GNSS Sensor Data, Contact Count and Mass
pmc-11510847.creator: Amarah Epp-Stobbe, Ming-Chang Tsai, Marc D Klimstra, David Niederseer, Mohsen Shafizadeh
pmc-11510847.description: The use of session rating of perceived exertion (sRPE) as a measure of workload is a popular athlete load monitoring tool. However, the nature of sRPE means the contribution of salient, sport-specific factors to athlete load in field sports is challenging to isolate and quantify. In rugby sevens, drivers of load include high-speed running and physical contact.

pmc-11536102.title: Associations between polygenic scores for cognitive and non-cognitive factors of educational attainment and measures of behavior, psychopathology, and neuroimaging in the adolescent brain cognitive development study
pmc-11536102.creator: Aaron J. Gorelik, Sarah E. Paul, Alex P. Miller, David A. A. Baranger, Shuyu Lin, Wei Zhang, Nourhan M. Elsayed, Hailey Modi, Pooja Addala, Janine Bijsterbosch, Deanna M. Barch, Nicole R. Karcher, Alexander S. Hatoum, Arpana Agrawal, Ryan Bogdan, Emma C. Johnson
pmc-11536102.description: BackgroundEducational attainment (EduA) is correlated with life outcomes, and EduA itself is influenced by both cognitive and non-cognitive factors. A recent study performed a ‘genome-wide association study (GWAS) by subtraction,’ subtracting genetic effects for cognitive performance from an educational attainment GWAS to create orthogonal ‘cognitive’ and ‘non-cognitive’ factors.

pmc-11648119.title: Tanshinone IIA attenuates fluoride-induced spinal cord injury by inhibiting ferroptosis and inflammation
pmc-11648119.creator: Qingfeng Shen, Shibo Ma, Lingbo Li, Yingpeng Xia
pmc-11648119.description: Excessive fluoride exposure can lead to health problems, such as fluorosis and neurotoxicity. However, effective therapeutic strategies for neurofluorosis remain elusive due to a limited understanding of the underlying molecular mechanisms. This study aimed to investigate the effects of Tanshinone IIA on spinal cord injury induced by high-fluoride exposure.

pmc-12402101.title: SlimVar for rapid in vivo single-molecule tracking of chromatin regulators in plants
pmc-12402101.creator: Alex L. Payne-Dwyer, Geng-Jen Jang, Caroline Dean, Mark C. Leake
pmc-12402101.description: Epigenetic regulation occurs over many rounds of cell division in higher organisms. However, visualisation of the regulators in vivo is limited by imaging dynamic molecules deep in tissue. We report a technology—Variable-angle Slimfield microscopy (SlimVar)—that enables tracking of single fluorescent reporters to 30 µm depth through multiple Arabidopsis thaliana root tip cell layers.

pmc-12403609.title: Long-read sequencing identifies ATXN3 repeat expansions, and transcriptomics reveals disease progression biomarkers and druggable targets for spinocerebellar ataxia type 3
pmc-12403609.creator: Chang Liu, Xin Wang, Chao Xu, Xiaoxiang Liu, Liyan Ke, Ying Li, Hang Zhang, Jianqiang Tan, Senwei Tan, Zitong Zhang, Liang Cheng, Yaqiong Ren, Lei Shi
pmc-12403609.description: BackgroundHereditary ataxias (HAs) are neurodegenerative disorders characterized by progressive cerebellar degeneration, with autosomal dominant spinocerebellar ataxias (SCAs) representing the most prevalent subtype. SCA3, the most common form worldwide, is caused by CAG repeat expansions in ATXN3, resulting in pathogenic ataxin-3 aggregation. However, the underlying molecular mechanisms driving disease progression remain incompletely understood.

pmc-13033489.title: Using gene methylation detection in bronchoscopic samples combined with morphology-based pathology for lung cancer diagnosis
pmc-13033489.creator: Xiaojuan Niu, Dixia Hu, Xia Li, Lisha Wang, Xunbo Wang
pmc-13033489.description: IntroductionLung cancer is a common malignant tumor with high incidence and mortality. Bronchoscopy is key for its diagnosis, but traditional morphology-based pathology has limitations like missed diagnoses. This study explored the auxiliary diagnostic value of gene methylation detection combined with morphology-based pathology in bronchoscopic samples.

pmc-13038563.title: Neuronal autoantibodies associated with poorer neuropsychological and motor outcomes 6 months after stroke: results from the PHYS-STROKE trial
pmc-13038563.creator: Charlotte Pietrock, Konrad Neumann, Kristin Rentzsch, Harald Prüss, Andreas Meisel, Matthias Endres, Alexander Heinrich Nave
pmc-13038563.description: IntroductionEmerging evidence suggests a role of neuronal autoantibodies (nAbs) for long-term stroke outcomes. However, data remain limited and many domains unexamined. We present a comprehensive analysis of nAbs and their association with a broad range of outcome measures at multiple timepoints in the six months following moderate stroke.

pmc-13091957.title: Associations of Neprilysin and Its Coding Gene Variation With Hypertension in Chinese Adults
pmc-13091957.creator: Junting Hu, Jing Duan, Jiexiang Jing, Qiu Zhang, Xianfeng Yu, Rongyan Zhang, Yuting Jia, Mingzhe Du, Penghao Wang, Xueyang Zhang, Yibing Jin, Xiangdong Yang, Mingzhi Zhang, Hao Peng, Yun Shen
pmc-13091957.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Neprilysin (NEP) degrades several vasoactive peptides and may contribute to blood pressure maintenance. This study aims to examine the associations between serum NEP levels and variants at its coding gene and hypertension in a general Chinese population. Leveraging the baseline blood specimens of the Gusu cohort, serum NEP was assayed, and 14 single‐nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in the MME gene were genotyped (10 passed the Hardy‐Weinberg equilibrium test) by MassArray for 2286 participants (mean age 52 years, 61.4% females).

pmc-13215443.title: Perinatal Neuroprotective Strategies and Intraventricular Hemorrhage in Preterm Infants ≤32 Weeks’ Gestational Age: A Prospective Study With a Historical Control Cohort
pmc-13215443.creator: Anu Sharma, Radhika Sujatha, Krishna Nesseril, Sobha Kumar
pmc-13215443.description: BackgroundIntraventricular hemorrhage (IVH) is a major complication of prematurity and a significant contributor to increased morbidity and mortality. There is no single intervention to eliminate IVH; however, implementing perinatal neuroprotective strategies (NPS) may help minimize adverse outcomes. Indian data on perinatal NPS and their association with IVH remains limited.

pmc-13246739.title: Anomaly-based data reduction for energy-efficient edge computing in IoT with LoRa
pmc-13246739.creator: Fadime Karadas, Bilal Usanmaz
pmc-13246739.description: Edge computing, a key component of Internet of Things (IoT) systems, enables data processing close to the data source. In low-power, resource-constrained IoT environments, it can reduce dependency on centralized cloud systems, lower communication load, and minimize overall energy consumption. However, transmitting all sensor data from edge devices still incurs significant communication and energy costs.

pmc-13366846.title: Development and validation of a multi-parametric MRI diagnostic model for differentiating hemangioma-like metastases from small (< 3 cm) hepatic hemangiomas: a size-based subgroup analysis
pmc-13366846.creator: Pengrui Gao, Funing Chu, Qingcheng Meng, Chongxiao Guan, Hongkai Zhang, Yong Zhang, Jinrong Qu
pmc-13366846.description: BackgroundHemangioma-like metastases (HM) are rare but treacherous hypervascular malignancies that mimic the imaging features of benign hepatic hemangiomas (HH), particularly when lesions are small (< 3 cm). This resemblance creates a “diagnostic grey zone,” often leading to misdiagnosis and inappropriate treatment delays.

pmc-13410613.title: Microfluidic Immunomagnetic Capture of Circulating Tumor Cells via On-Bead Antibody Conjugation
pmc-13410613.creator: Ming-Lin Tsai, Wen-Ching Hsieh, Sung-Chi Tsai, Yi-Chiung Hsu

pmc-13528998.title: Meningococcal disease epidemiology – United States, 2020–2023
pmc-13528998.creator: Amy B. Rubis, Basanta R. Wagle, Shreya Khuntia, Carolyn I. Wiest, Sandip Shrestha, Vishakh Walia, Rebecca L. Howie, Sara L. Eisen, Brittney Z. Thomas, Daya N. Marasini, Shalabh Sharma, Lucy A. McNamara
pmc-13528998.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundHigh quality surveillance data are important to monitor changes in incidence and better understand risk factors for meningococcal disease. This report summarizes meningococcal disease epidemiology from 2020 through 2023 in the U.S.MethodsEpidemiologic information and isolates obtained through Enhanced Meningococcal Disease Surveillance for meningococcal disease cases reported through the National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System (NNDSS) during 2020–2023 were included in the analysis.

pmc-13600650.title: Effects of thrombospondin-1 (THBS1) and toll-like receptor 4 (TLR-4) levels in the serum and synovial fluid of patients with knee osteoarthritis
pmc-13600650.creator: Yingjie Xu, Tian Zhen, Liang Mingjin, Xiaoyun Li
pmc-13600650.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundTo explore the changes in and significance of Thrombospondin-1 (THBS1) and Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR-4) levels in the serum and joint fluid of patients with knee osteoarthritis (KOA).Methods184 KOA patients admitted to our hospital between May 2022 and February 2025 were selected as the observation group, and 64 healthy adults who underwent physical examinations at the same hospital during the same period composed the control group.

pmc-13636101.title: Zufriedenheit von Patienten und Ärzten mit Videokonsultationen in der Dermatologie: Eine explorative Querschnittsstudie
pmc-13636101.creator: Felix von Krogh, Julia Zarnowski, Regina Treudler, Jan‐Christoph Simon, Anna‐Theresa Seitz

pmc-13637609.title: Frailty and low utilization of curative-intent surgical resection in nonmetastatic pancreatic cancer
pmc-13637609.creator: Lauren Raymond-King, Sean McGrath, Bhramar Mukherjee, Yiran Wang, Harsh Parikh, John Rothen, Pamela R Soulos, Cary P Gross, John W Kunstman
pmc-13637609.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundCurative-intent treatment for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma necessitates major surgery and chemotherapy, yet many patients do not undergo resection. Frailty may contribute to this phenomenon, but its prevalence and association with pancreatectomy in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma remains poorly defined.
